items.text: An Industrial Training Institute teaches a trade through mostly workshop practice.
A trade name tells you little.
Electrical, cooling, auto and plumbing trades can grow into your own service business.
Use this on every trade you shortlist.
Spend a day with an electrician, mechanic, welder or plumber.
List the factories, service centres, contractors and PSU units within a few hours of home that take ITI apprentices.
Private ITIs now outnumber government ones by the non-profit's count, and many are genuine.
Search the NCVT MIS site (ncvtmis.gov.in) by state and district.
Affiliation is given by trade and unit, and DGT orders list them one ITI at a time.

blocks.heading: Layers on Top of an ITI Trade

items.text: You do not need to own a shop.
A fitter, turner, machinist or welder who has worked in a factory can take small jobs from nearby units.
Wiring, plumbing, fit-out and fabrication jobs for housing societies and builders.

blocks.heading: Electric Vehicles, Solar, AI and Automation

items.text: Rooftop solar and electric two-wheelers need people who can install, test and repair them.
AI helps with fault lookup, estimates and manuals.
Read circuit and service manuals with an AI tool, then check the answer against your trainer.

visuals.title: SCVT and the Certificate

blocks.heading: 10th Fail and 12th
rows: Class 8 pass
A smaller set of trades. One government ITI lists Plumber and Sewing Technology as one-year trades for Class 8 pass.
Many popular trades ask for Class 10. In some states the same trade needs Class 8 under the state council (SCVT) and Class 10 with Maths and Science under the national council (NCVT).
Class 10 pass
Most trades. COPA, Food Production and Food and Beverage Service Assistant list Class 10 pass.
Engineering trades such as Electrician, Fitter and Mechanic Refrigeration and Air Conditioning list Class 10 pass with Science and Maths.
Class 10 fail
Only the Class 8 trades, if you hold a Class 8 pass. Otherwise clear Class 10 first, through a supplementary attempt or open schooling.
Ask the ITI for its written eligibility list for your trade. Rules differ by state and by institute.
Class 12 (any stream, including commerce)
Every trade open to a Class 10 pass is open to you. The ITI checks your Class 10 subjects, not your Class 12 stream.
A commerce student who skipped Science and Maths in Class 10 may be shut out of engineering trades but can still take COPA and service trades. Some newer trades ask for Class 12, so read each notice.

blocks.heading: ITI Trades By Sector
rows: Electrical and energy
Electrician, Wireman, Solar Technician (Electrical)

Electrician is listed as a two-year trade for Class 10 pass with Science and Maths. Solar Technician appears as a new trade in the 2026 affiliation orders and as a one-year course at a national skill institute.
Factories, utilities, contractors, builders, solar installers, households.
Auto and electric vehicles
Mechanic Motor Vehicle, Mechanic Diesel, Mechanic Electric Vehicle
Diesel is listed as one year in one state for Class 10 with Maths and Science under NCVT and Class 8 under SCVT. One state ITI lists Mechanic Electric Vehicle as a two-year state-council trade.
Dealerships, service centres, fleet operators, local garages.
Cooling and refrigeration
Mechanic Refrigeration and Air Conditioning
Two years, Class 10 with Science and Maths, in the Goa listing.
Service companies, malls, hotels, hospitals, home service.
Fabrication and machine shop
Fitter, Turner, Machinist, Welder, Sheet Metal Worker
Fitter is two years for Class 10 with Science and Maths. Welder and Sheet Metal Worker fall in the one-year group in a PSU apprenticeship notice.
Factories, workshops, shipyards, construction and fabrication units.
Electronics and instruments
Electronics Mechanic, Instrument Mechanic, Laboratory Assistant
Check the state prospectus. These trades appear in public sector apprenticeship notices at the higher stipend tier.
Electronics makers, plants, labs, repair and installation shops.
Construction and plumbing
Plumber, Carpenter, Draughtsman (Mechanical)
Plumber is one year for Class 8 pass in the Goa listing. Carpenter is a one-year trade in a PSU notice.
Builders, contractors, housing societies, home owners.

blocks.heading: Ranked By Growth and the Sales Layer
rows: Electrician, Wireman and Solar Technician
Scalable with a business layer
Wiring, panels and rooftop solar are local services that households and shops pay for directly. A salaried plant job follows a fixed ladder.

Who pays: home owners, shops, builders. They trust a neighbour's referral and a photo log of finished jobs. First sales step: one clear price per common job, then ask each happy customer for one referral.
Mechanic Electric Vehicle and Motor Vehicle
Scalable with a business layer
Dealership pay follows a ladder. A garage or a two-wheeler and three-wheeler EV service bench is the business layer.
Who pays: vehicle owners and small fleets. First sales step: a written estimate before work, and a repeat-service reminder list.
Mechanic Refrigeration and Air Conditioning
Scalable with a business layer
Cooling needs yearly service, so repeat customers are built in. Home and shop service contracts are the layer.
Who pays: homes, shops, clinics. First sales step: a seasonal service offer at a fixed price, sold to the customers you already have.
Plumber and Carpenter
Scalable with a business layer
Demand is local and steady. Small contracting and fit-out work give the layer.
Who pays: home owners and builders. First sales step: before and after photos and a fixed rate for repeat jobs.
Fitter, Turner, Machinist, Welder, Sheet Metal Worker
Scalable with a business layer
Plant jobs follow a fixed ladder. A small job-work shop, fabrication or maintenance contract is the layer, but it needs tools and working capital.
Who pays: small factories and builders. First sales step: one documented job with measurements, then a short list of what you can make or fix.
Electronics Mechanic and Instrument Mechanic
Scalable with a business layer
Salaried plant roles are modest. Repair benches and installation of cameras, inverters and instruments can be sold directly.
Who pays: shops, offices and small makers. First sales step: a fixed price list for the five repairs you do best.

blocks.heading: Apprenticeship After ITI: NAPS and NATS
rows: Stipend

HAL lists Rs 10,560 a month for one-year ITI trades and Rs 11,040 for trades of two years or more, Rs 10,900 for diploma and Rs 12,300 for graduate apprentices. Nuclear Fuel Complex lists Rs 11,040 for trades such as Electrician, Fitter and COPA and Rs 10,560 for Welder, Plumber, Carpenter and Diesel Mechanic.
A stipend is not a salary. Read the notice, because the figure depends on the employer and trade.
How to apply
Register on the Apprenticeship India portal, complete the profile with e-KYC, and apply to the named establishment. The trade on your ITI certificate must match the trade you choose.
You can do an apprenticeship once in the same trade, and notices exclude people who already completed one.
Length and fee
One year under the Apprentices Act, 1961. Neither notice listed an application fee.
It does not guarantee a regular job. Many units offer interview-based shortlisting, so seats are the first competitive stage.

blocks.heading: Government and PSU Routes for ITI Holders
rows: Railway Group D (Level 1)

The CEN 09/2025 notice listed 22,195 posts, and applications closed on 9 March 2026. Education: Class 10 pass, or an NCVT or SCVT ITI, or a National Apprenticeship Certificate. Pay is Level 1 with basic pay of Rs 18,000 a month. Stages: computer test, physical test, document check, medical. Sources differ on the age limit (one says 18 to 36, another a base of 33), so read the current notice.
Many applicants compete for each post and the physical test is a second hard stage. Keep a trade or apprenticeship running while you prepare.
Agniveer (Army)

Recent notices give an age band of 17.5 to 22 years. The Technical category lists Class 12 science with Physics, Maths and English at 50%, or Class 12 plus a one-year ITI at NSQF level 4 or above. One older notice also listed Class 10 with a two-year ITI or diploma, and we could not confirm it is current.
Agniveer is a four-year engagement and only a share of each batch is kept on. ITI alone after Class 10 is not the main door, so check which category lists your trade on the official Army site.
PSU and defence unit apprenticeships (HAL, NFC and similar)

Recent notices ask for an ITI pass in the trade, NAPS registration and, at one unit, Class 10 plus ITI with a maximum age of 25 for General, 28 for OBC and 30 for SC and ST. No application fee was listed.
This is training under the Apprentices Act, not a job. One notice states that it does not guarantee regular employment.
State and other public posts
State electricity boards, municipal bodies and other departments list ITI trades for technician and helper posts, with rules set by each notice.
Cycles and trades vary. Treat any one exam as a bet.

blocks.heading: ITI or Polytechnic: a Short Comparison
rows: Entry
Class 8 or Class 10, depending on the trade
Class 10 pass; some states ask for Maths and set a test or merit list
Length
Six months to two years in most trades
About three years
Style
Mostly workshop practice with some theory
More theory and drawing alongside labs
Typical first work
Technician, helper, apprentice, service work
Supervisor, junior engineer routes, technician
Bridge upward
Second-year diploma entry in some places, then lateral entry to B.Tech
Lateral entry to B.Tech second year
